subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard repairs and exact-head checks pass, should the privileged action revisions be accepted as one grouped update?
rationale: The mechanical defects are resolvable, but accepting new third-party code that receives secrets, write permissions, publishing credentials, and agent API keys requires protected owner judgment.

options.title: Approve synchronized batch
options.body: Accept the grouped update after source verification, guard repair, rebase, and green exact-head security and workflow checks.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex action updates for narrower owner reviews.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Defer the update if owner review or exact-head evidence remains incomplete.

recommendation.title: Approve synchronized batch
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update after source verification, guard repair, rebase, and green exact-head security and workflow checks.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the changed security and Dependency Guard boundary to this team.
